name: Light at night
summary: LEDs on 12V are the answer: bright, easy on power, and everywhere. Solar garden lights are complete self-charging systems; set them out by day and bring them in at night. Emergency exit lights hold a battery, charger and LEDs in one box, and 12V LED strips run straight off a car or solar battery.

parts.why: Bright, efficient light from almost any battery
Garden lights and exit signs use these
Protects the battery in a solar lighting setup
Turns lights on only when someone’s there
Limits current when wiring loose LEDs

tips: A handful of solar garden lights brought indoors gives enough light to move around and eat by.
Exit signs and emergency lights hold a battery, charger and LEDs. Office buildings have dozens.
A 3W LED strip runs a whole night on a 12V 7Ah UPS or alarm battery.
Never leave candles or fuel lamps burning unattended. There’s no fire service now.
